lead.headline: Two labs, one week: OpenAI and Anthropic both say their AI disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis
lead.summary: OpenAI announced three results on Monday: a proof of the local smoothing conjecture in every dimension (which also settles Kakeya), an existence proof for QCD and Yang–Mills in four dimensions, and a refutation of ETH, the ~30-year-old belief that 3-SAT needs exponential time, used in hundreds of hardness papers. Its model found the ETH disproof on 16 October and it was checked in Lean the next day; ETH's original proposers Impagliazzo and Paturi, with Ryan Williams, will lead the independent check. Hours later Anthropic posted its own paper, "A 2^o(n) Time Algorithm for 3-SAT", saying an internal Claude model found the core algorithm, also on 16 October, with 14M output tokens and no human input, also formalized in Lean. It's theoretical: the speedup is subexponential, not a practical SAT solver, and no human has fully checked either proof yet.

news.headline: Anthropic files to go public as ANT: $16.3B half-year revenue, first positive operating cash flow
news.summary: First-half 2026 revenue was up from $1.2B a year earlier, 80% of it consumption-based. Operating loss narrowed to $693M and operating cash flow hit $3.9B, while a $72.4B convertible-note charge pushed the net loss to $80.7B. More than 11,900 customers now pay $100K+ a year.

news.headline: GPT-6.1 Terra: OpenAI's cheap computer-use model, at half the API price
news.summary: Out in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, priced 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra. OpenAI says it scores 50.3% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 at max effort (vs 21.5% for GPT-5.6 Terra) and costs about 9x less per task than Claude Opus 5.5 on Agents' Last Exam. Benchmarks are OpenAI's own.

news.headline: Cloudflare's GLM-5.3 leaked other users' data into 155 responses via a KV cache bug
news.summary: Prompts over 681,280 tokens overflowed the prefill KV pool; an SGLang bug in disaggregated mode then let decode read stale pages from earlier requests and return HTTP 200. Fixed in September, disclosed now. If you run disaggregated SGLang, upgrade to v0.5.22 and check pool size against context length.

news.headline: FIN-FSA: 93% of Finnish financial firms use or plan to use AI
news.summary: In Finanssivalvonta's survey of 84 banks, insurers, pension and investment firms, use of generative and general-purpose models jumped from 74% to 90% in a year, and agentic AI showed up for the first time. The supervisor wants clearer accountability and risk management.
